title: Add 'Moments💞' option after Yes and display uploaded photos on a new decorated page

requirements.text: On the final slide ("Will You Be My Valentine?"), after the user clicks the existing "Yes! 💕" button and the "Forever Yours! 💕" content is shown, display an additional CTA option labeled exactly "Moments💞" without changing any other existing behavior or styling outside this addition.

quotes: After selecting yes option in will you be my valentine page display a option called "Moments💞".

acceptanceCriteria: When the user clicks "Yes! 💕" on the final slide, the acceptance message (containing the phrase "You are forever mine") still appears as it does today.
After the acceptance message appears, a new clickable option labeled exactly "Moments💞" is visible on that same final slide.
The existing "No" behavior remains unchanged (still shows the rejection message and then only shows the "Yes" option afterward).

requirements.text: Implement a new "Moments" page/screen that opens when the user clicks "Moments💞" and displays the two uploaded images (IMG_20251207_221903_037-2.webp and 20260106_172708-2.jpg) along with a single lovely English message and romantic decorative styling consistent with the current theme (hearts, soft gradients, card/glass effect).

quotes: When it is clicked open a new page then show these photos i uploaded with a lovely message and decoration.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Moments💞" navigates to a distinct view (separate from the carousel view) that is clearly a new page/screen.
The Moments page renders both images: IMG_20251207_221903_037-2.webp and 20260106_172708-2.jpg.
A visible, readable English "lovely message" is present on the Moments page (exact wording may be chosen by the implementer).
The Moments page uses romantic decorations (e.g., hearts/accents/soft glow) and does not look like an unstyled raw image list.
The Moments page provides a clear way to return to the main Valentine carousel/final slide (e.g., a "Back" button).

requirements.text: Fix the issue where uploaded photos are not visible by ensuring the two uploaded image files are included as frontend static assets and referenced correctly so they load in production builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Both uploaded images load successfully on the Moments page in a deployed/production build (not only in local dev).
Images are served from the frontend as static files (not via the backend canister).
No broken image icons or 404s occur for IMG_20251207_221903_037-2.webp and 20260106_172708-2.jpg.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components only).

Do not edit the immutable hook/bootstrap files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep the existing Valentine carousel content and Yes/No behaviors unchanged except for adding the "Moments💞" option and the new Moments page.
nonGoals: Adding backend storage, upload flows, or any database for photos.
Adding Internet Identity login requirements for viewing Moments.
Creating additional slides or changing existing Valentine text beyond what is necessary to add the new option/page.
